name: smart-sprint-planner
title: Smart Sprint Planner
description: Multi-role sprint planning plugin for YouTrack 2024.3+. Supports 9 functional roles with separate composition tables, resources, and history snapshots. Plugin settings live in a dedicated widget with server-side authorization.
changeNotes:
What's new since v3.35.0

📐 Scope drift after sign-off — “Validate” now remembers the agreed composition of a role, and everything that changes afterwards (added, removed, re-estimated, excluded, returned) shows up live: a drift mark on the role row, a “Changes since agreement” block in the role panel and a “Drift” badge in the sprint header. Return the composition to the agreed one and the marks disappear; the next “Validate” sets a new baseline.

👀 “Changed in another tab” hint — when you come back to the tab, the planner compares the sprint revision with the server and tells you if someone else has changed the sprint; your edits are merged on save.

🔵 Unestimated-task counter on the planning screen — every role header shows “unestimated: N” whenever active issues of that role have no estimate in YouTrack, so a manager sees an incomplete calculation at a glance.

🔵 Import preview — the sprint-history import dialog shows “Records to apply: N · overwritten: M · skipped: K” and recomputes it on every checkbox and mode switch, using the very same rule the import will apply.

🔵 A main menu that explains itself — instead of “Plugin not configured”, the main menu says why a project's settings are not picked up yet and offers a button that opens the planner tab inside the project; the button now works on YouTrack 2026.1 as well.

🛡 Reads that survive a hiccup — a transient YouTrack error (429, 5xx, a dropped connection) is retried twice with a growing pause instead of failing the screen, and no more than six reads run at once. Writes are never retried.

🔎 A request id in every refusal — error responses carry a cid, shown in the error text; the server writes one log line with that id, the status and the reason code, never the request body. Quote it in a bug report and the incident is found in seconds.

🔒 No sprint write without its revision — POST sprint-data without a numeric baseRev is refused with base_rev_required instead of silently overwriting concurrent edits; REST clients only, the widget already sends it.

🧭 TTM finds epics through the links table — the parent epic that folds stories in the TTM report is resolved by the “Hierarchy” role of the Task links screen instead of a hard-coded name pattern, so Russian and custom link-type names work.

📘 Coming from Jira? A glossary — a documentation chapter maps Story Points, Velocity, Complete Sprint and the rest to the planner's own terms.

⚠️ Data schema changed 3.35.0 → 3.39.0 — one optional key was added to the role history snapshot. Rolling back below 3.39.0 is safe only until the first “Validate” on the new version; after that it requires a YouTrack database backup taken before the update.

widgets.name: Smart Sprint Planner
widgets.description: Planner settings for the project: functional roles and issue fields, permission groups (validation / editing / assignee assignment / history clearing), planning modes. Sprint planning itself lives in the main-menu item «Smart Sprint Planner».

widgets.name: Smart Sprint Planner
widgets.description: Sprint planning from YouTrack's main menu: pick an accessible project where the planner is set up, plan sprint composition by role, allocate tasks, review history. Permissions and settings are checked against the selected project. Includes a «Backlog» module for triaging and laying pool tasks into roles/sprint.
